name: Sosipater
overview: Sosipater is a male figure mentioned in the New Testament, identified specifically as a kinsman of the Apostle Paul. Beyond this familial connection, Scripture does not provide additional details about his tribe or other personal notes. His mention highlights a personal relationship within the early Christian community.
namesAndTitles: The name Sosipater appears only once in Scripture and does not have a recorded meaning in the provided data. Therefore, it is simply recognized as a proper name without further significance noted in the biblical text.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture does not record family relationships for Sosipater beyond his identification as a kinsman of Paul. No other relationships are documented in the biblical record provided.
scriptureSignificance: Sosipater's significance lies chiefly in his close familial tie to Paul, which suggests a trusted and possibly influential role within the early church.
